name: Vesha Three-Rivers
source_profile: ● Vesha Three-Rivers (LN) is a respected horse breeder and negotiator who maintains friendships among the Thalenweald wood elves. She supports Mazra's diplomacy but insists that any agreement must explicitly protect the tribe’s traditional migration corridors.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 49 (source excerpt; may be partial)
